subject: Cannot install seewave in OpenSUSE 13.1 inux

messages.author: 0ee5fe037bbe475f
messages.subject: Cannot install seewave in OpenSUSE 13.1 inux
parts:
I have literally tried every remedy suggested here & elsewhere, but cannot get seewave installed in R on OpenSUSE 13.1 Linux.  fftw3 seems to be the stumbling point, but I have it installed - R cannot see it for whatever reason. Some suggested uploads for Ubuntu do not seem to exist in the RPM Linux world - eg. libfftw3-dev   Can this be right?

Problems with installing rpanel & rgl seemed to resolve, but not fftw and seewave

Any new suggestions out there for getting around this perennial problem? (other than to go back to my old slow iMac!)

messages.author: bfa183f4897a5619
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Cannot install seewave in OpenSUSE 13.1 inux
parts:
Looks like OpenSUSE calls the library header package libfftw3-devel (instead of libfftw3-dev as Debian/Ubuntu do). Do you have that installed in addition to the libfftw3 package? If not, try installing it and then giving the seewave build another try.

best,
jesse

messages.author: 0ee5fe037bbe475f
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Re: Cannot install seewave in OpenSUSE 13.1 inux
parts:
Hi Jerome

The CRAN info for fftw identified Olaf Mersmann (Dortmund, Germany) as the maintainer of the package.  I emailed him this morning and he wrote straight back.  He's going to install an OpenSUSE VM on his machine and try to debug the process for me.  It may come down to static versus dynamic versions and how R sees those.  I'm hopeful that Olaf can sort it for me.

Thanks for taking an interest in sorting my problem.

best wishes

Lawrie
